e8b_protocol_amendment.status: AUTHORISED BY THE USER; two BLOCKER corrections applied 2026-08-07 after review; SEVEN open issues must be closed and the amendment re-reviewed before any core cell runs

supersedes.target: master protocol section 20, the pre-registered native-BF16 evaluation clause
supersedes.quoted: The frozen language models are held in their native bfloat16 at all times, including during evaluation - they are never upcast. ... Pre-registered; any change is a stop-and-ask.
supersedes.scope_of_supersession: E8B only. The stop-and-ask required by that clause was raised and the user authorised the change on 2026-08-07.
supersedes.note: master protocol section 18's statement that the fp32 diagnostic is 'not a change to the authorised compute precision' is also superseded for E8B, because fp32 evaluation is now the operative path.

supersedes.target: master protocol section 7.4, the eight-point E8B likelihood recipe search
supersedes.scope_of_supersession: the SEARCH is abandoned. The eight-point grid table itself is retained as the historical definition; no further grid point is run and no winner is claimed.

supersedes.target: U4 (promote the winning search checkpoint into the matching core cell)
supersedes.scope_of_supersession: withdrawn entirely. No search checkpoint is promoted. Every core cell is trained fresh under this amendment.

A1_precision.training: BF16 autocast on the training path only, unchanged
A1_precision.frozen_model_identity: unchanged. The pinned SmolLM2-135M checkpoint at revision 93efa2f097d58c2a74874c7e644dbc9b0cee75a2 stores all 272 tensors as BF16 on disk. Canonical evaluation promotes those EXACT state values to FP32; BF16 is a truncated FP32 so the promotion is lossless. VERIFIED for the state_dict: promotion equals a direct FP32 load bitwise, and the promoted state round-trips to BF16 exactly.
canonical_applies_to: final R1, R2 and R3 evaluation
every final E8B comparison, including B3 minus B2
A1_precision.bf16_status: may be reported ONLY as a secondary deployment or efficiency diagnostic, explicitly labelled; never as a scientific accuracy and never as a selection basis
A1_precision.provenance_caveat: the frozen model's state_dict SHA-256 differs between dtypes (bf16 20add223..., fp32 d2f53e18...) because the hash covers serialised bytes. The VALUES are identical. Both hashes are recorded in every core record, and g2_provenance must record the EVALUATION dtype alongside the pinned load dtype.

buffer_caveat.status: an earlier draft claimed this verification covered the non-persistent rotary inv_freq buffers. It did not. That claim is WITHDRAWN: no code in this repository has ever inspected those buffers, and the claim is false as written because B3's inv_freq is fp32 and does not round-trip through BF16.

A2_search_abandoned.decision: the eight-point recipe search is permanently stopped
A2_search_abandoned.grids_1_to_3: preserved as EXPLORATORY / PROTOCOL-DIAGNOSTIC evidence only
prohibitions: no grid point is a final core result
no between-grid difference is reported as evidence of recipe superiority
A2_search_abandoned.reason_recorded: the three completed points are statistically indistinguishable under REAL paired McNemar tests computed from persisted per-row correctness vectors (exploratory_fp32_correctness.npz): grid1 vs grid2 exact p=0.9040 (b=1241, c=1234, discordant 2475), grid1 vs grid3 p=0.4858 (b=1279, c=1243, n_d=2522), grid2 vs grid3 p=0.5616 (b=1178, c=1149, n_d=2327). The paired 95 per cent half-widths are 97.5, 98.4 and 94.5 development rows against a TOTAL observed spread of 36 rows, and the measured single-arm seed spread elsewhere in this project (A1, 40k, seeds 0/1/2) is 45 rows, larger than the whole grid spread. Five more single-seed runs cannot resolve a difference smaller than the noise from changing one seed of one arm.
A2_search_abandoned.evidence_file: exploratory_fp32_correctness.npz, the per-row FP32 correctness vectors for grid points 1-3 on all 7,714 development rows

withdrawn_claim.claim: an earlier draft stated that the run-length-free ordering REVERSES the ordering by maximum, citing plateau means 0.53143/0.53222/0.53237
withdrawn_claim.why: that statistic was the mean of each run's top (n-7) epochs, so k depended on the run's own length and the statistic was NOT run-length free; it was also threshold-conditioned on the outcome variable and constructed after the three results were seen. Under a genuinely length-free statistic, the mean of the top k epochs with k fixed at the minimum run length of 16 for all three runs, the ordering is grid1 0.53322 > grid2 0.53123 > grid3 0.51205, which is the SAME as the ordering by maximum. There is no reversal.
withdrawn_claim.what_survives: the run-length CONFOUND itself is real and remains recorded as OI2: the maximum over epochs is biased upward by the number of evaluations, and the three runs had 30, 21 and 16 epochs. The confound is a reason not to interpret the ordering; it is not evidence that the ordering is reversed.
withdrawn_claim.effect_on_the_decision: none. Abandoning the search rests on the two auditable grounds above, both of which are unaffected.

A3_fixed_recipe.justification_recorded_explicitly: retained because it was the PRE-RESULT pilot and default configuration, not because it achieved the highest observed development score. No selection was performed on any observed result. This wording is binding on every E8B report.

A4_u4_withdrawn.consequence: all 18 core cells are trained fresh under this amendment

A5_final_matrix.pair_preservation: B1/B2/B3 all run at every scale and seed. No arm, scale or seed may be dropped automatically; if a gate fires, execution stops and returns to the user with pair-preserving alternatives.

A6_paired_b2_b3.requirement: for a given (scale, seed), B2 and B3 must share bitwise-identical trainable initialisation, identical data ordering, the identical fixed recipe and the identical evaluation protocol
A6_paired_b2_b3.mechanism: build_trunk_and_projection(seed, dropout) is called with the same seed for both arms, and the projection scale is taken from the same cached CPU copy of the pretrained embedding table for both, so the alpha buffer is bitwise identical across the pair; the training loader generator is seeded with the same seed; the recipe hash is identical for both arms
A6_paired_b2_b3.the_only_difference: the frozen language model is the pinned pretrained SmolLM2-135M (B3) or the pinned-seed random initialisation (B2)
A6_paired_b2_b3.purpose: B3 minus B2 is the primary causal pretrained-versus-random contrast and must remain a clean paired difference

amendment.A7_g14_fp32: specified in the g14_fp32 block below; frozen before core execution

A8_family_separation.requirement: the new FP32 fixed-recipe family must not resume or reuse any BF16 search checkpoint
mechanisms: the recipe dict carries protocol_family 'e8b-fp32-core-2026-08-07' and a precision string naming FP32 canonical evaluation, so every recipe hash in the new family differs from the search family (grid 1 was 8e94b4bf...)
verify_resume_checkpoint refuses on recipe-hash mismatch, so a search resume file cannot be loaded by a core run
core run names are e8b_{arm}_{scale}_seed{seed}, distinct from the search names e8b_B3_train_40k_seed0_search{n}, so no path collision exists
an explicit refusal check rejects any checkpoint whose recorded protocol_family is absent or different, with a recorded halt rather than an uncaught assertion

g14_fp32.canonical_scorer: the BATCHED R1 scorer with the frozen language model in FP32, at the evaluation batch size of 128, on the fp32 evaluation path
g14_fp32.cached_scorer_status: an optimised inference implementation; it must match the canonical argmax and never determines selection
g14_fp32.prefix_rule: one FP32 prefix tensor per row, SHARED by all scorers, so the gate isolates the scorer implementation and never confounds it with batch composition

validation_set.rationale: the old gate drew 64 random rows and could not see the region where a flip is arithmetically possible; measured tie density varies by an order of magnitude between checkpoints, so the set must adapt per checkpoint as well as retain a fixed component

stratum_P_pinned.rule: the 64 rows given by numpy default_rng(0).choice(n_dev, 64, replace=False), sorted
stratum_P_pinned.purpose: continuity with the superseded gate; fixed and checkpoint-independent

stratum_L_lowest_margin.rule: the 64 rows with the smallest FP32 canonical top1-minus-top2 margin from THIS checkpoint's own canonical development pass, ties broken by lowest row index
stratum_L_lowest_margin.purpose: the only region where an ordering flip is arithmetically possible; adapts to each checkpoint

stratum_O_ordinary.rule: 8 rows from each of the FP32 margin bands [1e-3,1e-2), [1e-2,1e-1), [1e-1,1), [1,inf), drawn with numpy default_rng(20260807 + band_index) from the sorted row list of that band
stratum_O_ordinary.purpose: confirms that ordinary margins never disagree

validation_set.union: P union L union O, deduplicated and sorted; expected about 160 rows
validation_set.pre_selection_invocation: stratum P only, because L and O are not meaningful at untrained initial weights

clauses.requirement: canonical (batched) argmax == brute-force argmax on EVERY row
clauses.on_failure: HARD HALT with an atomic JSON record

clauses.requirement: cached argmax == canonical argmax on EVERY row
clauses.on_failure: HARD HALT with an atomic JSON record

clauses.requirement: R2 brute-force constrained walk == R2 cached walk on EVERY row
clauses.on_failure: HARD HALT with an atomic JSON record

g14_fp32.no_exemption: no margin-based exemption, no tolerance band, no near-tie category. Any argmax disagreement halts.
g14_fp32.score_deltas: recorded as DIAGNOSTICS ONLY and can neither cause nor prevent a halt
g14_fp32.honest_characterisation: the halting clauses are SUBSTANTIVELY THE SAME as the superseded gate, which already required three-way argmax identity and already treated its 1e-4 score tolerance as informational. What changes is the substrate (FP32 instead of BF16) and the validation set (about 160 stratified rows instead of 64 random). The gate is expected to fire far less often, because the measured FP32 scorer deltas are about 2e-05 while the BF16 deltas reached 2.5e-01. It is NOT correct to describe G14-FP32 as a stricter clause.
per_run_recording: strata sizes and the SHA-256 of each stratum's row list
minimum and quantile FP32 canonical margins over the development set
counts of development rows below 1e-5, 1e-4 and 1e-3 FP32 margin
delta quantiles across the validation set
on halt: questionId, imageId, both candidate strings, canonical/brute/cached scores, canonical margin and both perturbations
